author: Arachadonic
body:
Welcome to Paradise!


Gallery of pictures with descriptions (read them please): http://imgur.com/a/jXJzm#0
Map Download including YAML file: https://www.mediafire.com/folder/bpl7f9747rlwt/Paradise
Notes: 
This map was made 100% by me. I did it in one day and it took me the whole day but I don't regret it. This is the first map I have ever proper made and submitted to a server so I am proud of myself for making this even if it does not get accepted! If you have any critism I would prefer it be constructive so I can adapt the map and make it perfect.

You are unable to climb up the mountain as I have tested it and made it this way. All of the fighting will mainly take place on the beach or in the caves which I have made easily accessible to both teams. You will spawn with Speed 1 set to infinity as this map is slightly big.
